instruction: Candid studio photograph, full shot. The instructor in a black leotard and white tights (R1) stands on the right, facing away in profile, looking back towards the student. Soft, bright natural light illuminates the clean white setting, creating a clean, minimalist aesthetic with a gentle and focused atmosphere.
